notes.title: Flagged wallets: mostly retail by count, almost entirely bots by dollars.
notes.body: Of 6,291 wallets flagged at p<0.01 by the orthogonality test, 62% are active retail, 21% are sophisticated, only 16% are algorithmic. But profitability tells the opposite story: 4,306 (68.4%) of the flagged set were profitable, generating $152.5M in aggregate. The 1,026 flagged bots captured $137.6M of that — 90% of all flagged-wallet gains flow to the algorithmic 16%, with mean PnL of $134K per bot vs $2.2K per retail wallet. The screen catches private information across every wallet class; the dollars accrue almost entirely to the algos who can act on it at scale.

notes.title: Bloomberg: 100,000 Polymarket accounts booked four-figure losses since 2025
notes.body: Bloomberg's analysis of 233M trades using the DV-PMI methodology found the typical bot averaged 89 trades per active day vs 2.2 for non-bots. Carried by Yahoo Finance, BeInCrypto, FA Magazine, Benzinga, and several wire services.
